title: Danmaku shield
description: Keep live-room danmaku out by keyword, user or near-duplicate text; the rules live on this device.
enabledDescription: When off, every rule stands down for the moment
similarityEnabledDescription: Hides danmaku that closely match one shown moments ago; platform messages only.
similarityCacheDurationDescription: Identical or similar messages will not be shown again during this period
similarityMaxCacheSizeDescription: Limits the memory used by the similarity cache
repeatEnabledDescription: Keep the first copy when different users send the same text. Local and system messages are unaffected.
userFieldHint: Type a user name to block
clearConfirmDesc: The list empties; add entries again whenever you need them.
duplicateEntry: This entry is already on the list
effectNote: The rules apply to the room chat immediately.
blockEmoteOnlyDescription: Danmaku with emoticons and no text are not shown; your own lines are never blocked.
blockLongDescription: Danmaku longer than the set length are not shown (an emoticon counts as one).
blockLongLengthDescription: The longest line still shown, 10–100 (an emoticon counts as one).
douyuSuspectedDescription: Turn on to hide suspected automated or event chat heuristically; ordinary chat may also be hidden
